nodes.description: Owner address in BotProtected; set to msg.sender in the Kattana constructor and used as the only authorization for delegate() and list().
Address of the Ferrum bot-protection contract set in the BotProtected constructor; invoked with a raw low-level call inside the checkBots modifier.
Uniswap pair address computed in the Kattana constructor via pairFor(wETH, address(this)) and passed into the bot-protection call.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and overwritten arbitrarily in list().
Public nested allowance mapping; mutated in approve(), decremented with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and pre-set to uint(-1) in the constructor.
Total token supply (10,000,000 * 1e18) declared at construction and used to compute the owner allocation in list().
Immutable-looking Uniswap V2 router interface instance used by list() to add ETH liquidity.
WETH address used together with address(this) to derive the Uniswap pair.
Constant public decimals value 18.
Public token name 'Kattana'.
Public token symbol 'KTN'.
Base constructor that stores the caller-supplied bot-protection contract address.
checkBots modifier: performs an unchecked low-level call into the arbitrary botProtection address before executing the guarded function body.
Sets owner = msg.sender, derives uniPair, and grants unlimited allowances to the router and to the pair.
Public payable transfer wrapper that simply calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom carrying the checkBots modifier; updates balances and allowances with unchecked arithmetic.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value without any guard.
Owner-only function that performs an arbitrary delegatecall with caller-supplied address and calldata.
Internal pure helper that deterministically computes the Uniswap V2 pair address from two tokens.
Owner-only distribution/liquidity function: rewrites balances and adds ETH liquidity with a block.timestamp deadline.
Caller-controlled address used for owner assignment, allowance indexing it and authorization checks.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used to build the Uniswap deadline in list().

Unchecked low-level call to an externally supplied botProtection contract with a hardcoded selector; the boolean result is only required, the returned bytes are discarded and the target can execute arbitrary logic mid-transfer.
Unchecked a.delegatecall(b) in delegate(): arbitrary code executes in the storage context of the token contract.
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath, allowing silent overflow of the balance mapping.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed after a raw >= check but without SafeMath.
block.timestamp + 600 used as the Uniswap router deadline, making the liquidity transaction time-dependent.
Constructor address of the external bot-protection contract.
Source address of the transfer in transferFrom.
Destination address of the transfer in transferFrom.
Amount moved in transfer/transferFrom and forwarded to the bot-protection call.
Spender address granted an allowance in approve().
Target contract address for the delegatecall in delegate().
Arbitrary calldata bytes forwarded to the delegatecall in delegate().
Amount of tokens assigned to the contract and added as liquidity in list().
Array of recipient addresses distributed to in list().
Array of amounts assigned to each recipient in list().
First token of the pair computed in pairFor.
Second token of the pair computed in pairFor.
Boolean result captured from the low-level bot-protection call and then required.
Bytes returned by the bot-protection call; never decoded or validated.
Lower-ordered token address produced by the sort in pairFor.
Higher-ordered token address produced by the sort in pairFor.
Loop index iterating over _tos/_amounts in list().

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _botProtection is stored into the botProtection state variable.
owner is assigned directly from the untrusted msg.sender in the constructor.
transferFrom uses msg.sender to decide whether allowance must be decremented.
_from parameter is used for balance and allowance lookups in transferFrom.
_to parameter receives the transferred balance in transferFrom.
_value parameter drives all state changes in transferFrom.
_value flows into the unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value overflow site.
_value flows into the unchecked allowance subtraction site.
msg.sender indexes allowance[_from][msg.sender] before the unchecked subtraction.
_spender is written into the allowance mapping in approve().
Caller-supplied address a is the delegatecall target.
Caller-supplied bytes b become the delegatecall payload.
_numList is assigned to balanceOf[address(this)] and used as the liquidity amount in list().
_tos array drives the distribution loop in list().
_amounts array provides the balances written in the list() loop.
block.timestamp is read to compute the router deadline.
The timestamp-derived deadline is passed as a parameter to addLiquidityETH inside list().
tokenA is compared/sorted inside pairFor.
tokenB is compared/sorted inside pairFor.
token0 is the sorted local derived inside pairFor.
token1 is the sorted local derived inside pairFor.
notABot local holds the result of the bot-protection call that gates checkBots.
isNotBot bytes returned by the bot-protection call are left unvalidated in checkBots.
_value is encoded into the raw calldata sent to botProtection from the checkBots modifier.
Loop index i controls iteration over recipient/amount arrays in list().
Kattana constructor invokes the BotProtected base constructor.
The checkBots modifier wraps the execution of transferFrom.
transfer() delegates all work to transferFrom.
The low-level bot-protection call is executed as part of the checkBots modifier body before the guarded function runs.
delegate() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
list() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
The delegate() body performs the delegatecall operation.
The mid-transfer low-level call into the arbitrary botProtection contract lets that contract reenter transferFrom before balances are updated.
delegatecall transfers execution to the caller-supplied address in the context of this contract.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor argument only exists to initialize the botProtection state variable.
_from is only meaningful inside the transferFrom state update.
_to is only meaningful inside the transferFrom state update and event emission.
_value drives the balance/allowance mutations and the bot check inside transferFrom.
_spender is only used as the allowance key in approve().
The address a is consumed solely by the delegatecall operation.
The bytes b are consumed solely as delegatecall payload.
_numList is only used to set the contract balance and liquidity amount in list().
_tos is only iterated over inside the list() distribution loop.
_amounts is only read while assigning balances in list().
tokenA is only used to compute the pair address in pairFor.
tokenB is only used to compute the pair address in pairFor.
The boolean is a transient return capture of the bot-protection call made by the modifier.
The returned bytes are an unused transient capture of the same low-level call.
token0 exists only as the sorted intermediate inside pairFor.
token1 exists only as the sorted intermediate inside pairFor.
The loop counter is a transient index of the distribution loop in list().
